integrity: Actual complete proof and a standalone exact-integer finite checker are embedded. Finite experiments do not establish the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the single quadratic base twice the golden ratio. Relies on the classical Skolem--Bang equivalence and Fibonacci strong divisibility. Unindexed literature could contain an equivalent theorem. Independent audit not performed.
title: A unique exceptional disjointness offset for powers of twice the golden ratio
